# Source tree map {#sec-appj}

Use this page to find where a part of snapy lives in the repository and which chapter explains it. It has three
tables, all at the code pin: one row per top-level directory and build file; one row per module directory of
`src/`; and one row per file of the V3 structure that a reader looks for by name: the six parts of the
`MeshBlock`, the stage executor, the flux register and the budget. "Built" means the directory is in the source
lists of the `snap` library, or of its CUDA library, in {{< code src/CMakeLists.txt >}}; a directory that is not
is said so. A row's last column names the chapter or section that covers it, or "none".

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Map the repository's directories, modules and V3 files to what each owns and the chapter that
covers it.

**Data.** The tree at the pin and its build files; no generated content.

**Placement.** Reference page, outside the solver.

**Activation.** None; the map describes the default build.

**Guarantee / limits.** A row says what a directory or file holds and whether the build compiles it; the physics
is in the linked chapters; "none" means no chapter covers it at the pin.

**Evidence.** The build files cited below; 18 directories of `src/` hold 98 `.cpp` files, all in the `snap`
library's source lists, and 9 of them hold one `.cu` file each, all in its CUDA library's.
:::

### Top-level directories

| directory | what it owns | covered in |
|---|---|---|
| `src/` | the C++ core: the `snap` shared library, plus a CUDA library when `CUDA` is on; one directory per module (@tbl-appj-src) | @sec-ch01 |
| `snap` | a symbolic link to `src`, so the code includes its own headers as `<snap/...>` | none |
| `python/` | the `snapy` package (`package_dir` in {{< code setup.py >}}): bindings in `csrc/` compiled into the extension `snapy.snapy`, type stubs in `snapy/`, the `pd-combine` and `pd-inspect` tools in `api/` (the `[project.scripts]` of {{< code pyproject.toml >}}) | @sec-ch01-python, @sec-ch14-tools |
| `tests/` | the ctest suite: C++ and Python tests and the `run_*` drivers registered in {{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}} | @sec-appc, @sec-ch16 |
| `examples/` | example drivers (`.cpp`, among them `run_hydro.cpp`) and their input decks (`.yaml`) | [Install and run](#sec-preface-install), @sec-ch10-kinetics |
| `cmake/` | build macros, `Find*` modules for the dependencies, fetch scripts for Eigen, fmt, GoogleTest, kintera, UCX and yaml-cpp | @sec-ch12-build, @sec-ch01-dependencies |
| `api/` | `pd-run` and `slurm.sbatch`, launch scripts installed with the package (`script-files` in {{< code pyproject.toml >}}) | @sec-ch14-launch |
| `tools/` | developer scripts: `gen_options.py`, which CMake and `setup.py` run to generate the option code from `src/options/` ({{< code tools/gen_options.py >}}), the execution benchmark `bench_execution.py` and `lane_c_lines.py` | @sec-ch15-options |
| `external/` | a copy of Gloo, put on the include path of the `snap` library | @sec-ch14-backends |
| `patches/` | patches the build applies to the fetched Eigen and yaml-cpp | none |
| `docs/` | the Sphinx documentation and derivation notes | none |
| `.github/` | the CI, release and deployment workflows | none |
| `CMakeLists.txt`, `configure.h.in`, `setup.py`, `pyproject.toml` | the build: options ({{< code CMakeLists.txt >}}), generated macros, the Python extension and its requirements | @sec-ch12-build, @sec-ch12-macros, @sec-appe |
| `communication.md`, `V3_ROADMAP.md`, `V3_PROGRESS.md` | design and status notes: how communication is organised, and the V3 plan and its progress tracker | @sec-appg |

: Top-level directories at the pin. {#tbl-appj-top}

### Modules of `src/`

| directory | what it owns | built | covered in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bc/` | external boundary functions, internal (solid) boundaries | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch11 |
| `chemistry/` | the chemistry step a block or a Mesh registers (`ChemistrySource`, kintera kinetics) | yes | @sec-appe-components |
| `coord/` | coordinate systems and metrics: Cartesian, spherical-polar, gnomonic cubed sphere | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch03 |
| `diagnostics/` | the budget read off the flux register, and the consumer interface for diagnostics that read the register | yes | @sec-ch06-conserves, @sec-ch13 |
| `eos/` | equations of state: ideal gas, ideal moist, moist mixture, shallow water, tabulated (`aneos/`); the EOS status (`EfStatus`) | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch02, @sec-ch08-efstatus |
| `forcing/` | forcing modules: constant gravity, Coriolis and axial momentum, diffusion, heating, relaxation, sponges | yes | @sec-ch07, @sec-ch06-cell |
| `hydro/` | the hydro module: its options, the sweep, the flux register, flux positivity, well-balanced references, gravity work, `balance_column` | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch01-hydro, @sec-ch04, @sec-ch05, @sec-ch08-theta |
| `implicit/` | the vertically implicit correction: assembly, block sweep, redistribution, its gravity work | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch06-vic, @sec-ch09-vic-options |
| `input/` | deck key checks | yes | @sec-ch01-options |
| `layout/` | block layouts (slab, cubed, cubed sphere), the exchange, the seam register, process groups over Gloo or UCX | yes | @sec-ch03-layouts, @sec-ch03-seamreg, @sec-ch14-backends |
| `math/` | headers only: LU routines used by `implicit/` | headers | @sec-ch09-vic-pivot |
| `mesh/` | `MeshBlock` in six parts, `Mesh`, the stage executor, its segments, the state store and the precision policy (@tbl-appj-v3) | yes | @sec-ch01-construction, @sec-ch01-mesh, @sec-ch16-capture |
| `options/` | the options schema in YAML, one file per options block; `tools/gen_options.py` generates the option code from it at build time | generated | @sec-ch15-options, @sec-appi |
| `output/` | output types (NetCDF, PnetCDF, restart), the gridded writer core, the budget time series, the combine and field loaders | yes | @sec-ch15-output, @sec-ch15-restart |
| `recon/` | reconstruction: donor cell, PLM, CP3/CP5, WENO3/WENO5, PPM, the $x_1$ reference | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch04-framework, @sec-ch05-wbx1 |
| `riemann/` | Riemann solvers: Roe, LMARS, HLLC, shallow-water Roe, plume Roe | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch04-riemann |
| `scalar/` | the passive-scalar module | yes | @sec-ch01-scalar, @sec-ch08-scalar |
| `sedimentation/` | sedimentation velocities and their hydro coupling | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch08-sed |
| `utils/` | logging, CUDA helpers, the step type `StepDt`, the typed-constant cache | yes, with CUDA | @sec-ch01-dispatch |

: Module directories of `src/` at the pin; "with CUDA" means the directory also holds a `.cu` file of the CUDA
library, except `layout/`, whose glob is listed but holds none. {#tbl-appj-src}

{{< code src/add_arg.h >}} defines `ADD_ARG`, the macro that declares every options field;
{{< code src/snap.h >}} fixes the index names of the state vector (@sec-ch01-layout).

### Files of the V3 structure

| file | what it holds | covered in |
|---|---|---|
| {{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp >}} | `MeshBlock`, part BlockInit: options, modules, the state store, the initial state | @sec-ch01-construction |
| {{< code src/mesh/meshblock_advance.cpp >}} | part BlockAdvance: the time step and one stage | @sec-ch09-cfl, @sec-ch09-rk |
| {{< code src/mesh/meshblock_exchange.cpp >}} | part BlockExchange: exchange phases and boundary functions | @sec-ch03-exchange, @sec-ch11-timing |
| {{< code src/mesh/meshblock_redo.cpp >}} | part BlockRedo: the retry flags, the decision, the restore | @sec-ch09-redo, @sec-ch08-redo |
| {{< code src/mesh/meshblock_output.cpp >}} | part BlockOutput: outputs, the cycle diagnostics, the end of a run | @sec-ch13-cycle, @sec-ch15-output |
| {{< code src/mesh/meshblock_restart.cpp >}} | part BlockRestart: initialization from a restart file | @sec-ch15-restart |
| {{< code src/mesh/meshblock_options.cpp >}} | `MeshBlockOptions` from the deck, among them the execution keys | @sec-ch15-options |
| {{< code src/mesh/mesh.cpp >}} | `Mesh`: several blocks per process, their exchange and the global phase | @sec-ch01-mesh |
| {{< code src/mesh/stage_executor.cpp >}}, {{< code src/mesh/segment.cpp >}}, {{< code src/mesh/exchange_cut.hpp >}} | the stage executor: the schedule of a stage, its segments, capture and replay as CUDA graphs, exchange cuts | @sec-ch16-capture |
| {{< code src/mesh/state_store.hpp >}} | the block's state in fixed storage | @sec-appg |
| {{< code src/mesh/precision_policy.hpp >}} | the precision policy: storage, compute and accumulation dtype per quantity | @sec-appg |
| {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp >}} | the flux register and its monitor | @sec-ch08-carry, @sec-appg |
| {{< code src/hydro/sweep.cpp >}} | the hydro sweep | @sec-ch04 |
| {{< code src/layout/exchange.cpp >}}, {{< code src/layout/seam_register.cpp >}} | the exchange and the cubed-sphere seam register | @sec-ch03-exchange, @sec-ch03-seamreg |
| {{< code src/diagnostics/budget.cpp >}}, {{< code src/output/budget_series.cpp >}} | the budget per interval and its time-series file | @sec-ch06-conserves, @sec-ch15-output |
| {{< code src/utils/step_dt.cpp >}} | the step size as a host number or a device scalar | @sec-appg |

: Files of the V3 structure at the pin; where no chapter section covers a file yet, @sec-appg gives its V3 lane.
